subgroup_flags.classification_notes: ARDS only: inclusion required moderate-to-severe ARDS (PaO2/FiO2 ≤150). Obesity: BMI median 29 (IQR 26-32), not ≥30, so mixed. Timing: only known relative to enrolment, so unclear. PTP target: end-expiratory PTP of 0-2 cmH2O achieved by absolute subtraction.

extraction_flags.overlap_evidence: The paper states 'Of these, forty patients had also been enrolled in a prior study [8]', which is Boesing et al. 2022, Crit Care 26:82, confirming overlap with boesing_2022.
unclear_items: data only in figures: lung elastic dynamic power values in prone position are not reported numerically in text, only in Fig. 4A/B.
timing_subgroup unclear: timing of intervention known only relative to enrolment, not intubation or ICU admission.

extraction_flags.general_notes: The study is a within-patient crossover comparing baseline (PEEP/FiO2 table) with Peso-guided ventilation in supine and prone positions. The primary endpoint is the effect of prone positioning on lung total elastic power, which is a physiologic outcome.
